draft.subject: Next step in your Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for your patience while we look into your two open tickets, the notification badge count and the VAT invoice. My colleague Tariq is still on both, and I'm keeping an eye on them too. For reference, a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings, and I'm happy to walk through that with you.

I also saw you created your first project and sent an invite, nice start. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week help you get the project moving?

Best,
Chidi
